title: MCP server /health hangs; plugin trust bootstrap and triage submit time out
summary: The wordpairs workspace MCP server process is alive but GET /health?nonce=... does not answer (5 s, 30 s and 90 s client timeouts), workflow.triage.report times out in qbrain-ai-repl after 30 s, and the plugin writes no failsafe record for the failed triage submit. A hostile-validation reviewer therefore cannot load memories, read QBrain or write its session-log turn.
lastError: Triage agent failed with state Error with exit code 1. See captured agent output for details.
qualification: Exact catalog group readback. Research status and intake/replay identity are separate claims.
